source: Last Island LITE 7.3 source-extracted a-57_tex0.png (existing asset in user's repository)
observation: When used directly as a raylib diffuse RGBA texture, most terrain pixels were transparent. In actual Android virtual screenshot the exact sky RGB covered 78.3381% of pixels, with the ground visually absent. Native ray collision nevertheless reported spawn height 22.30350.
corrective_action: Convert the existing source texture to RGB8 before upload, preserving RGB while treating alpha as material-mask data rather than diffuse opacity.
limitations: Original Unity shader/material layer mapping is not reconstructed
RGB8 preview is not guaranteed to match original terrain appearance
